_info: Tracks and questions offered in every new quest (English).

questions.text: What was your school like when you were little?
follow_ups: What was your teacher's name?
What did you keep in your school bag?
What made you laugh in class?

questions.text: Tell me about your first day of school.
follow_ups: Who took you there that day?
Do you remember your teacher?
How did you feel when you came home?

questions.text: What did you do during the summers?
follow_ups: Where did you spend your holidays?
Who did you play with?
Which summer stayed with you the most?

questions.text: What games did you play with your friends?
follow_ups: What was your favourite outdoor game?
Who did you play with most often?
Did you have a favourite toy?

questions.text: What was your childhood home like?
What were you afraid of as a child?
How did you meet Grandpa?
follow_ups: What did you think of him the first time?
Where did you go next?
What did your parents say?

questions.text: Who was your best friend?

Do you remember your neighbours?
Which dish reminds you of your childhood?
follow_ups: Who used to make it?

Do you still know how to make it?

questions.text: Which recipe would you like to pass on to me?

questions.text: What job did you dream of doing?
